The refactor is complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Class moves (via `git mv`, preserving history)

| Class | New package | New path |
|---|---|---|
| `HFileBootstrapIndex` | `org.apache.hudi.common.bootstrap.index.hfile` | `hudi-hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hudi/common/bootstrap/index/hfile/HFileBootstrapIndex.java` |
| `HoodieHFileUtils` | `org.apache.hudi.io.hadoop` | `hudi-hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hudi/io/hadoop/HoodieHFileUtils.java` |
| `HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader` | `org.apache.hudi.io.hadoop` | `hudi-hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hudi/io/hadoop/HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader.java` |

All three moved from `hudi-common` **into** `hudi-hadoop-common`, plus internal import fixups (`HFileBootstrapIndex` now imports its `BootstrapIndex` superclass and the relocated `HoodieHFileUtils`).

## Simplified constructor API

Replaced the four `CacheConfig`-based public constructors with the two required no-cache ones, delegating to a single private constructor that builds a default `CacheConfig` internally from `storageConf`:
- `HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader(StorageConfiguration<?>, StoragePath, Option<Schema>)`
- `HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader(StorageConfiguration<?>, StoragePath, HoodieStorage, byte[], Option<Schema>)`

## Caller updates
- **`HoodieAvroFileReaderFactory`** — switched to the new constructors, dropped the now same-package import and the unused `CacheConfig`/`Configuration`/`HoodieStorageUtils` imports.
- **`BootstrapIndexType`, `HoodieTableConfig`** (in `hudi-common`, which can't depend on `hudi-hadoop-common`) — replaced `HFileBootstrapIndex.class.getName()` with the new FQN string literal, since the class is loaded reflectively anyway.
- **`HoodieBootstrapConfig`, `HoodieStreamer`** — updated imports to the new package (both modules depend on `hudi-hadoop-common`).
- **`BootstrapCommand`** — updated the hardcoded default class-name string.

## One necessary supporting change
`HoodieHFileUtils` uses `SeekableByteArrayInputStream`, defined package-private in `HoodieAvroHFileReaderImplBase` (which stays in `io.storage`). Since the utils class now lives in `io.hadoop`, I widened that nested class to `public`.
